description: Qwen3.5-0.8B greedy generation workloads (G5, plan section 11), fp32x ONNX Runtime GenAI bundle on CPU. Requests name prompts of model-pipeline/protected/qwen3.5-0.8b/reference/generation.jsonl. Path 'ids' starts from the reference prompt ids; path 'text' renders the messages with the owned chat template and tokenizer (timed as 'template'). Every generation is greedy with a fixed max_new_tokens and is compared with the reference output ids (exact, up to max_new_tokens), so a fast but different generation fails the series. Prompts with tools run only on the ids path (the chat API takes messages only).
